title: 310. Read N Characters Given Read4

examples.explanation: Only three characters exist, so the reader stops early.
Exactly the whole file is requested.
Twelve characters fill three read4 calls exactly.

hints: The answer is simply the file prefix of length min(n, file length).
Think in read4 chunks: full groups of four plus one final partial group.
An empty file or n = 0 both yield an empty string.
